overall_summary: The channel shows initial viewer traction leaning towards 'self respect' and personal boundaries topics, particularly touching upon phone interactions (chats, numbers, status). However, overall view counts are low (mostly under 40 views) and engagement is sparse, indicating low sample confidence and a need for controlled exploration.

winning_patterns.evidence: Videos centered around 'self respect' with phone-related hooks (e.g., 'उंगली उसी चैट पर रुकी थी' at 40 views, 'ब्लू टिक्स आज छिपा दिए' at 31 views, and 'बिना नाम के सेव किया था नंबर' at 27 views) perform relatively better than abstract emotional topics.
winning_patterns.action: Double down on real-life digital boundary moments combined with self-respect themes.

weak_patterns.evidence: Broad hooks like 'रात के दो बजे' (12 views) or generic poetic setups ('मेज पर रखी चाय ठंडी हो गई' at 5 views) underperformed compared to specific micro-actions.
weak_patterns.action: Avoid generic time-of-night tropes and focus on hyper-specific physical actions involving a smartphone.

next_video.concept: A realization moment while removing someone from the close friends or restricted story list on Instagram/WhatsApp, shifting focus from waiting for their view to reclaiming personal peace.
next_video.opening_direction: क्लोज़ फ्रेंड्स लिस्ट से उसका नाम हटाने ही वाला था कि...

next_video.reason: Aligns with the proven 'self respect + phone micro-action' pattern while testing a slightly different platform feature (stories/close friends) to expand the digital boundary niche.

experiment: Testing if moving the digital boundary hook from chat/numbers to story-viewing/close-friends lists retains the higher view count seen in self-respect videos.
